description: B-1193 (Mike, 2026-11-15: the host decides what follows a networked co-op or counter-op mission). A listen host and one client start co-op Defection as network_coop_stage_transaction_smoke does; after 40 s of play the host ends the mission with every objective complete (--debug-end-mission, the level script's own end). Each machine shows only its own player's results; the host's commit returns the client to the lobby; the host presses its default Next Mission, whose lobby start takes the client along from its results screen into the next mission. Asserts the final objective statuses before the stage end, one results push per machine, the host's choice and the second mission live on both. B-1196: 20 s into the first mission the host clones a guard (--debug-clone-guard, idle), as a guard's own clone would appear; the client must make the same chr from the host's SVC_NPC_SPAWN, so no move names a chr it lacks.
